actives.name: Salicylic acid (BHA)

caution.redness: Can sting or dry already-irritated skin; start every other day.
caution.moisture: Can be drying; pair with a moisturiser.

actives.note: Oil-soluble exfoliant that clears clogged pores.

actives.name: Benzoyl peroxide

caution.redness: Often irritating at first; 2.5% is gentler than higher strengths.

actives.note: Kills acne bacteria; can bleach fabrics.

actives.name: Adapalene (retinoid)

caution.redness: Retinoid irritation is common in the first weeks.
caution.moisture: Expect dryness and peeling early on.

actives.note: Retinoid for acne; results usually take about 3 months.

actives.name: Retinol / retinal

caution.redness: Can irritate sensitive or red skin; start 2–3 nights a week.

actives.note: Vitamin A derivative; use at night with sunscreen by day.

actives.name: Bakuchiol
actives.note: Plant-derived; marketed as a gentler retinol alternative, evidence is limited.

actives.name: Azelaic acid
actives.note: Calms redness, helps acne and uneven tone.

actives.name: Niacinamide
actives.note: Well tolerated multitasker for oil, tone and barrier.

actives.name: Glycolic acid (AHA)

caution.redness: Acids can sting red or sensitive skin.
caution.moisture: Can be drying at higher strengths.

actives.note: Surface exfoliant for dullness and texture.

actives.name: Lactic acid (AHA)

caution.redness: Gentler than glycolic but can still sting.

actives.note: Milder AHA that also helps hydration.

actives.name: Mandelic acid (AHA)

caution.redness: Larger molecule, usually gentler; still patch test.

actives.note: Gentle AHA.

actives.name: PHA (gluconolactone)
actives.note: Very gentle exfoliant.

actives.name: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid & derivatives)

caution.redness: Pure ascorbic acid at low pH can sting.

actives.note: Antioxidant for dullness and dark spots; works best with daily sunscreen.

actives.name: Tranexamic acid
actives.note: Used for stubborn pigmentation such as melasma.

actives.name: Alpha arbutin
actives.note: Brightening agent for dark spots.

actives.name: Kojic acid
actives.note: Brightening agent; can irritate.

actives.name: Licorice root extract
actives.note: Soothing, mildly brightening.

actives.name: Hyaluronic acid
actives.note: Humectant that draws water into the skin.

actives.name: Glycerin
actives.note: Classic humectant.

actives.name: Ceramides
actives.note: Barrier lipids that reduce water loss.

actives.name: Squalane
actives.note: Lightweight emollient.

actives.name: Urea

caution.redness: Higher strengths can sting broken skin.

actives.note: Humectant and gentle keratolytic.

actives.name: Panthenol (pro-vitamin B5)
actives.note: Soothing humectant.

actives.name: Centella asiatica (cica)
actives.note: Soothing plant extract.

actives.name: Allantoin
actives.note: Soothing.

actives.name: Zinc PCA
actives.note: Oil-control helper; modest evidence.

actives.name: Sulfur
actives.note: Old-school acne active; smells.

actives.name: Tea tree oil

caution.redness: Essential oil; a known cause of contact allergy.

actives.note: Weak evidence for mild acne; allergy risk.

actives.name: Caffeine
actives.note: Common in eye creams; effects are temporary and modest.

actives.name: Peptides
actives.note: Evidence is mostly small, brand-funded studies.

actives.name: Green tea extract (EGCG)
actives.note: Antioxidant, soothing.

actives.name: Mineral UV filters (zinc oxide / titanium dioxide)
actives.note: Daily broad-spectrum SPF 30+ is the base of preventing spots and photo-ageing.

actives.name: Organic UV filters
actives.note: Daily broad-spectrum SPF 30+ protects measured gains.

actives.name: Fragrance / parfum

caution.redness: Fragrance is a leading cause of cosmetic contact allergy; risky for red, reactive skin.

actives.note: No skin benefit.

actives.name: Essential oils

caution.redness: Common sensitisers; avoid on red or reactive skin.

actives.note: No proven skin benefit.

actives.name: Drying alcohol (alcohol denat.)

caution.moisture: High on the list it can be drying.

actives.note: Solvent; fine low in the list, drying near the top.
